Question ID: ENG4_U06_L07_GP_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.ENG4.C.03

Publication Scenario: A senior team has a one-minute narration, three slides, an infographic, a research summary, and source credits for a public-service announcement about postsecondary training. Which option best supports publication-ready multimedia communication?

answer.text: A. Add animations before checking source credits or audience access.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Animations are secondary to credibility and accessibility. A presentation should first make sources, evidence, and audience access secure.

answer.text: B. Verify that narration, slides, infographic, research summary, and source credits work together for the audience.

feedback.text: Correct. This answer best applies Unit 6 communication skills with clear reasoning, evidence, audience awareness, and publication readiness.

answer.text: C. Publish as soon as the product contains several media parts.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Having several media parts is not enough. Publication readiness requires each part to support the purpose, audience, and source responsibilities.

answer.text: D. Remove evidence so the product feels shorter and more casual.

feedback.text: Incorrect. Shorter is not always stronger. Unit 6 communication still needs credible evidence, even when the style is concise.
